add_executable(protopyc
    ProtopycMain.cpp
    CppGenerator.cpp
)

# Directories the Makefile generated by `protopyc --emit-make` compiles and
# links against. A protopyc run from its build directory uses the build tree
# (headers in the source tree, libraries next to their targets); an installed
# protopyc uses the installation, with paths relative to its bin directory so
# a relocated prefix keeps working. Lists are ':'-separated. The PROTOPYC_*
# environment variables override them at run time (ProtopycMain.cpp).
file(RELATIVE_PATH _protopyc_install_include "${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_BINDIR}" "${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_INCLUDEDIR}")
file(RELATIVE_PATH _protopyc_install_lib "${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_BINDIR}" "${CMAKE_INSTALL_FULL_LIBDIR}")
set(_protopyc_install_include_dirs "${_protopyc_install_include}")
set(_protopyc_install_library_dirs "${_protopyc_install_lib}")
if(DEFINED PROTO_CORE_PREFIX)
    # protoCore is installed separately: add its own directories.
    string(APPEND _protopyc_install_include_dirs ":${PROTOPYTHON_PROTOCORE_INCLUDE_DIR}")
    string(APPEND _protopyc_install_library_dirs ":$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:protoCore>")
endif()

file(GENERATE OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/$<CONFIG>/protopyc_paths.h CONTENT
"// Generated by CMake (src/compiler/CMakeLists.txt). Do not edit.
#pragma once
#define PROTOPYC_DEFAULT_CXX \"${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER}\"
#define PROTOPYC_BUILD_BINDIR \"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:protopyc>\"
#define PROTOPYC_BUILD_INCLUDE_DIRS \"${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include:${PROTOPYTHON_PROTOCORE_INCLUDE_DIR}\"
#define PROTOPYC_BUILD_LIBRARY_DIRS \"$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:protoPython>:$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:protoCore>\"
#define PROTOPYC_INSTALL_INCLUDE_DIRS \"${_protopyc_install_include_dirs}\"
#define PROTOPYC_INSTALL_LIBRARY_DIRS \"${_protopyc_install_library_dirs}\"
")

target_include_directories(protopyc PRIVATE
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/$<CONFIG>
)

target_link_libraries(protopyc PRIVATE
    protoPython
    protoCore
)

install(TARGETS protopyc
    RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR}
    COMPONENT protoPython
)
